_company: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank (ADIB) – Egypt S.A.E., EGX: ADIB. NOT ADIB Group PJSC (ADX: ADIB).
_rule: [R-TERM-01] — every terminal is built on a DISCLOSED useful life, and a life this desk chose is not a disclosed life.

route_one_policy_note.result: FAILED — a range across seven classes, not a life

what_the_note_states.Other equipment: 10 years (8 years in the FY2015 filing)

route_one_policy_note.source: ADIB-Egypt audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2018, accounting-policies note (L) Fixed assets; the same table with 'Other equipment' at 8 years appears in the FY2015 filing
route_one_policy_note.why_it_fails: The note gives a life per class and no weighting between them, and the classes span 1 to 20 years. Finding a range is not finding a life, and picking a point inside one is the choice this rule exists to forbid. On the names read under this rule so far, route one has given a usable scalar about once.

route_two_derived.identity: depreciable gross cost / annual depreciation charge
route_two_derived.source: ADIB-Egypt audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2018, note 24 'Fixed assets – Net of accumulated depreciation' — the cost and accumulated-depreciation blocks for both years
route_two_derived.route: text layer (pdftotext -layout), arithmetic-confirmed: each year's roll-forward (opening NBV + additions − disposals − impairment − depreciation + depreciation on disposals) foots to the printed closing NBV, and cost less accumulated depreciation reproduces the same NBV
route_two_derived.held_against_route_one: 9.1 to 12.3 years sits inside the 1-to-20-year span the policy note discloses, in its middle. That is what a branch network looks like: the largest block by far is 'Other assets' — fit-out, IT and equipment on 5-to-10-year lives — at EGP 761mn of EGP 1,096mn gross cost, against EGP 240mn of land and premises on 20 years.
route_two_derived.one_reason_the_total_ratio_is_OVERSTATED: Land is not depreciated and is not separable: the note prints a single 'Land & premises' column. The ex-land-and-premises figures are given beside the totals so both bounds are visible; the truth is between them, nearer the ex-land number because premises are only part of that column.
route_two_derived.adopted_note: NO LIFE IS ADOPTED, and for a bank that is a statement about the construction rather than about the evidence. A bank's terminal is built on equity — dividends, free cash flow to equity and return above the cost of equity [L-111] — not on a reinvestment identity in which a PP&E life sets maintenance capex. ADIB-Egypt's entire net fixed-asset base is EGP 953mn against total assets of EGP 347bn: 0.27%. The life is recorded because the rule says read it while the filings are open, and because a study that later wants it should find it here rather than choose one.
